slots.title: Privacy Policy: header spot
slots.brief: A chunky flat-graphic padlock fused with a small retro CRT terminal: the screen shows abstract blue bar-chart glyphs (no letters or numbers) and the keyhole glows hololive blue (#3fb8f5). A few halftone dots and thin hairline sparkles around it. Clean vector shapes, blue key colour with deep ink-navy (#0a0c11) shading and one crisp white highlight. Centred, three-quarter view, generous padding.
slots.notes: Shown at about 176px to the right of the page title on desktop, hidden on phones, over both light and dark page backgrounds: bold silhouette, few details, transparent background, no text.

slots.title: Usage policy: header spot
slots.brief: A small closed rulebook with a blue bookmark ribbon, a referee's whistle resting on it, and two stacked poker-style play-money chips leaning against it (plain star emblem on the chips, no letters, numbers or currency signs). Clean flat-graphic vector shapes with light halftone shading, hololive blue (#3fb8f5) as the key colour, deep ink-navy (#0a0c11) shading and one crisp white highlight. Centred, three-quarter view, generous padding.
slots.notes: Shown at about 176px to the right of the page title on desktop, hidden on phones, over both light and dark page backgrounds: bold silhouette, few details, transparent background, no text.
